# Baseline: 1 modules in 1 pairs of a header and a source file under src/.
# Generated by `dotnet run --project Runner -c Release -- generate`; change the generator, not this file.
# Compiler flags come from the runner (bench.json cppFlags), passed when it configures the build.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(Baseline LANGUAGES CXX)

add_executable(Baseline
    src/main.cpp
    src/group0/group.cpp
    src/group0/vector001.cpp
)
target_include_directories(Baseline PRIVATE src)
